mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates and increases liquidity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and expanded corporate financing.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp over 3 months, or Rank IC over any 3-year window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) for 3 consecutive months indicate a housing sector contraction that precedes broader consumer demand weakness, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for 3 months, or Rank IC over any 3-year window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0) during expansionary phases signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in residential investment (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand that boosts corporate sales visibility, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as equity valuations adjust to higher growth expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC over any 3-year window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent price pressures that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher real rates compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) for 3 consecutive months indicate labor market contraction that precedes reduced corporate hiring and economic slowdown, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls for 3 months, or Rank IC over any 3-year window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 QoQ > 1.5%) during late-cycle expansion phases signals economic overheating that triggers profit-taking in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate policy tightening.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 QoQ exceeds 1.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year window remains below 0.03.
